sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
so a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts.

the ban on
these four substances continues there.

findings.why: The yellow chromate passivation (COAT-ZN-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium (CrVI), which the end-of-life vehicle rules ban. The ban now continues under Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 and replaces the old directive. The text itself says to check the Official Journal before quoting dates.

sources.quote: Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: SUP-G is the source of CL-115. It has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part, because the hardness was above tolerance. The NCR is still open, so it applies to this change.
